CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL( Financial_Year_Tenure__c , 'Current FY Year') , TEXT(YEAR(TODAY())) & '-' & TEXT(YEAR(TODAY())+1), IF(ISPICKVAL(Financial_Year_Tenure__c , 'Next FY Year'), TEXT(YEAR(TODAY())+1) & '-' & TEXT(YEAR(TODAY())+2), IF(ISPICKVAL(Financial_Year_Tenure__c , 'Following FY Year'), TEXT(YEAR(TODAY())+2) & '-' & TEXT(YEAR(TODAY())+3),'')))
